effectiveSourceCorrection.sourceText: With the trainer, gradually moisten and work each unlabelled sample to a suitable mouldable condition. Record grittiness, smoothness, stickiness, ball strength and ribbon behaviour before naming. In the NRCS flow, Sand does not retain a ball after moisture checks; Loamy Sand forms a ball but no ribbon; gritty Sandy Loam can form a weak ribbon. Do not call all sandy-group material the same class. Clay-rich and loamy groups also need several clues; these are field estimates, not observations already made on today’s trays.
